one_liner: Gumroad has a free, self-serve REST v2 API with OAuth2 and non-expiring personal access tokens, so a toolkit can ship now. An official MCP server is claimed but not verifiable from the supplied pages.
auth_notes: Create an application under Settings > Advanced. For multi-user use, build a Redirect URI handler and use the OAuth authorization-code flow (gumroad.com/oauth/authorize, then api.gumroad.com/oauth/token). For your own account, generate a non-expiring access token from the application. Scopes include account, view_profile, edit_profile, edit_products, edit_emails, view_sales, view_payouts, view_tax_data, mark_sales_as_shipped and edit_sales. Composio also lists OAUTH2 as managed.
access_notes: Any account can create an application and generate a token. Gumroad has no subscription plans. A third-party source (Mattering) reports no review queue, partner programme or billing gate. This comes from a third-party guide, not Gumroad's own docs.
blocker_notes: No blocker found. Third-party users must authorize via OAuth. Some endpoints need specific scopes beyond account. Tax and earnings endpoints are US-only. There is no documented sandbox.

evidence.quote: you'll need to build a [Redirect URI](https://www.oauth.com/oauth2-servers/redirect-uris/) handler to generate access tokens for each of your users
if you only want to use the API on your own Gumroad account, you can manually generate an access token
we do not expire the `access_token` until it is revoked manually
there is no review queue, no partner programme and no billing gate in front of it
Eighty one nodes in total, thirty three that read and forty eight that act, covering every operation Gumroad documents.
Gumroad has an official API: a seller creates an application and an access token to manage their own products, sales and subscribers and to verify license keys.
